# Funded fix round for task 3, then the stop note

The CR loop has used its ordinary rounds and its one escalated round. The header `**Amend-grant:** fund 1 fix rounds` funds exactly one more fix. That fix runs below, and one CR re-review follows it. The tree is not committed during this round, and no `plan_tracker` write happens.

One gap in the material I was given: the funded-round rules are said to live in `reference/fix-loop.md`, but the excerpt I have only covers the escalated round. So I use the plain in-place repair worker from Dispatch and omit `model:`. The escalation model override applies only to the one escalated round, which has already been used.

## 1. Funded fix dispatch (in place, integrated wave)

The fix goes to one plain implementer in the branch checkout. It is not a nested wave, does not use `worktree`, and is not fanned out. Before the accepted-wave commit, an integrated wave gets one in-place repair worker.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<original task 3 "Validate frame" text, verbatim>
<task 3 Spec: anchors + absolute spec path in /workspace/project>
<Tests: block + Files: Create:/Test: paths, verbatim>

## Previous review report (fix trigger)
<latest CR report verbatim - FIX_FIRST, finding src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard,
 Behaviour-change: no, TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)>

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test frame.test.mjs

<status protocol verbatim: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT>`
})
```

The payload carries no commit or staging instruction. Per the scenario, the fix returns `DONE` with a nonempty tracked delta.

## 2. Parent scoped gate, staging, and the Fix delta

Rerun the scoped command, then stage everything so the whole diff includes all deliverables:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

The scenario says the scoped command passes.

Next, record the tree-after with the fix-delta block, with `FD_ROOT=/workspace/project` (the integrated branch checkout):

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Key the printed SHA as tree-after for this wave's CR. Tree-before is the tree recorded at the escalated CR re-review's dispatch. Produce the delta from the two trees:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <tree-before> <tree-after>
```

The delta is nonempty, so the re-review proceeds. If the block exits nonzero, stop dispatch and report the shell error.

## 3. CR re-review

The triggering report says `Behaviour-change: no`, so this is a CR-only re-review.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<code-reviewer.md template filled:>
DESCRIPTION: task 3 "Validate frame" - funded fix for missing length guard
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: <task 3 text verbatim from plan>
BASE_SHA: <WAVE_BASE_SHA>
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test frame.test.mjs

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
<latest CR report verbatim>

<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md "Re-review: trajectory verdict", verbatim>

## Fix delta
<output of git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <tree-before> <tree-after>>`
})
```

The re-review returns `FIX_FIRST` with `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)` and the same length-guard finding. The funded round is spent, so there is no further dispatch. There is also:
- no wave commit (`reset --soft` / `commit`),
- no `plan_tracker` `complete`,
- no worktree cleanup.

Task 3 stays `in_progress` and the phase stays `implement`.

## 4. Stop note (inline; the turn ends here)

```
Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: frame validation still reads the frame without first checking its length, so a short or truncated frame is not rejected before access.
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Fix options:
  a) add a length check at src/frame.ts:21 that rejects frames shorter than the required size before any field is read, with a test in frame.test.mjs for a truncated frame
  b) amend plan task 3 / its spec anchor to state the minimum frame length and the expected rejection behaviour, so the guard has an unambiguous contract

Pick one, or give another fix.
```

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Use the single funded round authorized by `**Amend-grant:** fund 1 fix rounds`. Keep task 3 `in_progress`. This is an in-place repair of the integrated, uncommitted wave—not a new wave or a fan-out. No commit occurs unless review accepts the wave.

The following are **next commands and payloads, not executed actions**. Payload substitutions denoted `VERBATIM_*` mean the complete available text, inserted without summarizing it.

### 1. Record the pre-fix tree

The checkout still contains the implementation reviewed by the escalated CR. Record that tree before dispatching the funded repair:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Retain the printed SHA as `CR_TREE_BEFORE` for this wave. A nonzero exit stops dispatch.

### 2. Dispatch the one funded fix

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Implement the single funded repair for task 3, "Validate frame".

## Task Description
${VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_TASK_3_TEXT}

## Context
This is an in-place repair of an integrated, uncommitted singleton code
wave. Spec review has accepted. The ordinary loop and its one escalated
round have finished without acceptance. The exact header
"**Amend-grant:** fund 1 fix rounds" authorizes this one additional fix.

## Spec anchors
${VERBATIM_TASK_3_SPEC_ANCHORS}

## Review report to address
${VERBATIM_ESCALATED_CR_REPORT}

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

TEST_CONTRACT:
${VERBATIM_TASK_3_TESTS_BLOCK_AND_TEST_PATHS}

${VERBATIM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_PROTOCOL}
`
})
```

Do not add a worker commit or staging instruction. Consume the stipulated `DONE` result.

### 3. Run the scoped gate, stage deliverables, and record the review tree

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
```

After the stipulated passing result:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" add -A
```

Then run the entire tree-capture block:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Retain its printed SHA as `CR_TREE_AFTER`. Generate the delta using those two captured tree SHAs:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" diff --binary "$CR_TREE_BEFORE" "$CR_TREE_AFTER"
```

Insert the complete output as `FIX_DELTA` below. The scenario stipulates that it is nonempty.

### 4. Dispatch the funded CR re-review

`Behaviour-change: no` requires CR only, not an SR-first reroute. Preserve the original wave base and review the current integrated worktree.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Use the supplied requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md template and
code-quality-reviewer instructions. Review only; do not modify files.

DESCRIPTION:
Task 3, "Validate frame": integrated wave implementation and its funded repair.
The parent scoped gate passed after the repair.

PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
${VERBATIM_ORIGINAL_TASK_3_TEXT}
${VERBATIM_TASK_3_SPEC_ANCHORS}

BASE_SHA: ${WAVE_BASE_SHA}
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

Review the staged and unstaged current checkout against BASE_SHA,
not a new commit range.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
${VERBATIM_ESCALATED_CR_REPORT}

## Fix delta
${FIX_DELTA}

${VERBATIM_CODE_QUALITY_REVIEWER_TRAJECTORY_BLOCK}
`
})
```

Here, `VERBATIM_CODE_QUALITY_REVIEWER_TRAJECTORY_BLOCK` is the complete supplied “Re-review: trajectory verdict” instruction block, including its classification rules.

### 5. Consume the fixed result and stop

The supplied funded CR result remains `FIX_FIRST` with:

```text
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)
```

The single funded round is exhausted. Dispatch no further fix or review. Do not commit, complete task 3, or advance phases. End the turn with this stop note:

Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: Frame validation still lacks the required length guard after the single funded repair.
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Fix options:
  a) Add the missing length guard before frame processing and explicitly authorize another repair-and-review round.
  b) Amend the frame-validation requirement and task 3 to define the intended length-handling contract, then explicitly authorize implementation and review of that change.

Pick one, or give another fix.
